Master file corruption

Failure signal

A master file corruption condition is reported or detected during archive.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for archive does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Verify container structure, decode every frame and sample, and compare the stored checksum.

Corrective action

Quarantine the file and restore the last verified master before generating new derivatives.

Prevention

Add this verification to the archive gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
